Disables and checks loopback tx-udp-segmentation offload for XDP network setup.

# Purpose
This file defines a configuration stage that manages the loopback interface `lo` with `ethtool`. It disables the `tx-udp-segmentation` offload because that feature conflicts with AF_XDP and can cause loopback UDP packets to be dropped when UDP segmentation is enabled. The [`enabled`](<#enabled>) function limits the stage to systems that use the `xdp` network provider and are not running in a network namespace, while [`init_perm`](<#init_perm>) declares the root privilege needed to change the device setting. The [`init`](<#init>) function clears the `FD_ETHTOOL_FEATURE_TXUDPSEG` feature on `lo`, and [`check`](<#check>) verifies that the feature is disabled before the configuration is accepted.
